title: Aspen Aerogels, Inc.
content:
Aspen Aerogels, Inc. is a US-based manufacturer of flexible silica aerogel insulation blankets, built on more than two decades of aerogel technology development. Its Pyrogel line (XTE, XTF, HPS) serves high-temperature refining, petrochemical, FPSO and power applications with hydrophobic protection against corrosion under insulation (CUI), while Cryogel Z provides cryogenic and LNG insulation with an integral vapor barrier, jet-fire protection and acoustic attenuation. The company also makes thin aerogel thermal barriers for electric-vehicle battery packs.

For buyers, Aspen's blankets deliver ultrathin, lightweight insulation that cuts installation time and space versus conventional materials, backed by a technical services team for specification and engineering.
excerpt: US manufacturer of Pyrogel and Cryogel aerogel blankets for high-temperature, cryogenic/LNG and EV battery thermal insulation applications.
